name: @lacspace/postplan
description: Choose a post format (video / single image / carousel / text) per story and platform, so a feed like Facebook gets a natural mix instead of all videos. Rule-based and deterministic — platform fit, what the story can actually produce, a breaking-news nudge, and a don't-repeat-the-last-few mix penalty — with an optional cheap AI tie-break (injected llm) only when two formats are nearly tied. Zero dependencies, isomorphic.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
